author: Adam Savage’s Tested
description:
Adam's love for Texas Hold'em has yielded a few poker-inspired builds, and he recently found new inspiration in replica plaques from the Casino Royale--his favorite James Bond film! After sourcing chips and plaques accurate to the movie, Adam builds what he imagines would be the custom chip racks and high-end storage case used to move that set around the casino.

Apache Poker Chips: https://www.apachepokerchips.com/product/casino-royale-sample-chips/
